description: This file defines a feature handler for listing comments associated with an article identified by a slug in a .NET application following the CQRS pattern, utilizing MediatR for messaging, Entity Framework Core for data access, and custom error handling.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Contains the request and handler classes for listing comments for an article.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the comment listing request by fetching the article with including comments and author info, handling the case where the article is not found, and returning the comments envelope.
